General Notes:

1. All units are equipped with larger radiators in a flared carbody to accommodate separate radiator cores for diesel engine jacket water and for aftercoolers.
2. All units are painted with UP's "Building America" slogan and U.S. flag decal, in memory of 11 September 2001.
3. In April 2005, Union Pacific began complying with the new federal guidelines for better visibility at night by applying a yellow frame stripe to new locomotives, replacing UP's long-standing use of a red frame stripe. The first SD70Ace to receive the new yellow stripe was UP 8334, delivered on April 21, 2005. For unknown reasons, the deliveries of new EMD units to UP has not been in numerical order, so the last unit to receive the original red stripe was UP 8326, delivered on May 29, 2005. In between, some units received red stripe and some yellow stripe. Photographic research has shown that in the total group of 115 units in the UP 8309-8423 number series, 22 units (UP 8309-28, 8330, 8333) were delivered with red stripe; and 93 units UP 8329, 8331, 8332, 8334-8423) were delivered with yellow stripe. _(photo confirmation furnished by Ryan Martin) ([List of SD70ACe units, sorted by delivery date])_

Notes:

3. UP 8365 was sent directly for 90 days of cab signal testing to the AAR facility near Pueblo, Colorado; formally delivered to UP in September 2005.
